metadata.author: reh3376
metadata.description: Validates POST /v1/jiminy/strict (deterministic governance toggle, /strict mode) and GET /v1/jiminy/strict (mode-read endpoint added by JIMINY-MODE-001, 2026-08-02). Uses a dedicated session_id so the contract test never flips strict mode for real agent sessions; the base case enables and the restore_disabled variant turns it back off, leaving no state behind. Disabled-path contract (503 {error: 'jiminy guidance is not enabled'} when JIMINY_ENABLED=false) is documented as a skip variant — the live stack runs with Jiminy enabled.

variants.name: restore_disabled
variants.description: Toggle strict mode back off for the contract session (state hygiene) and assert the disabled shape.

variants.name: missing_session_id
variants.description: Empty session_id is a request-validation failure (400, not 500).

variants.name: get_read_mode
variants.description: GET /v1/jiminy/strict (JIMINY-MODE-001, 2026-08-02) — reads current mode for a session. Was 405 pre-JIMINY-MODE-001; now returns 200 with {mode, strict, session_id, boot_default, default_session}.

variants.name: method_guard_put
variants.description: PUT (and DELETE/PATCH) remain rejected with 405 — only GET + POST are contracted.

variants.name: disabled_contract_503
variants.skip_reason: Requires JIMINY_ENABLED=false + restart; documented contract: 503 {error: 'jiminy guidance is not enabled'}.
